findings: The three Tattu samples preserve manufacturer-labelled nominal capacity, exact SKU, explicit S/P configuration and supplied connector variant. Generic custom connector options were excluded.
Panasonic BK-3HCC and BK-3MCD min. capacity and 1.2 V were read from actual HTML. Four-cell retail/charger kit quantity did not create a new cell model.
Molicel minimum and typical capacities remain separate; nominal voltage is not replaced by charge voltage. M65A printed revision/date is retained without asserting newest revision.
The independent LiFePO4 review found ANR chemistry text on PDF page 1 and unresolved LF105 terminal versions. The locator was corrected before assembly and LF105 is excluded from verified targets.
All 32 added base identities were checked for overlap with the original 12; 12 pack configurations do not inflate count through connector-only variants.
limitations: This is a sample review of manufacturer text, not a complete independent re-audit of every field or every new model.
Neither root nor the LiFePO4 reviewer examined LF105 linked feature-image pixels; image-only terminal identifiers remain unverified.
No school procurement coverage, individual asset performance, charger compatibility, safety certification, marketing performance claim or newest-source revision is established by this review.
Audit records are not canonical source records or assembly inputs; their URLs are not added to the 61-source catalog count.
No application registration feature, API, migration, live database write, deployment or application integration test was performed.
